    24→// reconstructSaveBroadcastDataColumnSidecars reconstructs, if possible,
    25→// all data column sidecars. Then, it saves missing sidecars to the store.
    26→// After a delay, it broadcasts in the background not seen via gossip
    27→// (but reconstructed) sidecars.
    28→func (s *Service) reconstructSaveBroadcastDataColumnSidecars(
    29→	ctx context.Context,
    30→	slot primitives.Slot,
    31→	proposerIndex primitives.ValidatorIndex,
    32→	root [fieldparams.RootLength]byte,
    33→) error {
    34→	startTime := time.Now()
    35→	samplesPerSlot := params.BeaconConfig().SamplesPerSlot
    36→
    37→	// Lock to prevent concurrent reconstructions.
    38→	s.reconstructionLock.Lock()
    39→	defer s.reconstructionLock.Unlock()
    40→
    41→	// Get the columns we store.
    42→	storedDataColumns := s.cfg.dataColumnStorage.Summary(root)
    43→	storedColumnsCount := storedDataColumns.Count()
    44→	numberOfColumns := params.BeaconConfig().NumberOfColumns
    45→
    46→	// If reconstruction is not possible or if all columns are already stored, exit early.
    47→	if storedColumnsCount < peerdas.MinimumColumnCountToReconstruct() || storedColumnsCount == numberOfColumns {
    48→		return nil
    49→	}
    50→
    51→	// Retrieve our local node info.
    52→	nodeID := s.cfg.p2p.NodeID()
    53→	custodyGroupCount, err := s.cfg.p2p.CustodyGroupCount()
    54→	if err != nil {
    55→		return errors.Wrap(err, "custody group count")
    56→	}
    57→
    58→	samplingSize := max(custodyGroupCount, samplesPerSlot)
    59→	localNodeInfo, _, err := peerdas.Info(nodeID, samplingSize)
    60→	if err != nil {
    61→		return errors.Wrap(err, "peer info")
    62→	}

    64→	// Load all the possible data column sidecars, to minimize reconstruction time.

   116→// scheduleMissingDataColumnSidecarsBroadcast schedules the broadcast of missing
   117→// (aka. not seen via gossip but reconstructed) sidecars.
   118→func (s *Service) scheduleMissingDataColumnSidecarsBroadcast(
   119→	ctx context.Context,
   120→	root [fieldparams.RootLength]byte,
   121→	proposerIndex primitives.ValidatorIndex,
   122→	slot primitives.Slot,
   123→) error {
   124→	log := log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   125→		"root": fmt.Sprintf("%x", root),
   126→		"slot": slot,
   127→	})
   128→
   129→	// Get the time corresponding to the start of the slot.
   130→	genesisTime := s.cfg.clock.GenesisTime()
   131→	slotStartTime, err := slots.StartTime(genesisTime, slot)
   132→	if err != nil {
   133→		return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to calculate slot start time")
   134→	}
   135→
   136→	// Compute the waiting time. This could be negative. In such a case, broadcast immediately.
   137→	randFloat := s.reconstructionRandGen.Float64()
   138→	timeIntoSlot := broadcastMissingDataColumnsTimeIntoSlotMin + time.Duration(float64(broadcastMissingDataColumnsSlack)*randFloat)
   139→	broadcastTime := slotStartTime.Add(timeIntoSlot)
   140→	waitingTime := time.Until(broadcastTime)
   141→	time.AfterFunc(waitingTime, func() {
   142→		// Return early if the context was canceled during the waiting time.
   143→		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   144→			return
   145→		}
   146→
   147→		if err := s.broadcastMissingDataColumnSidecars(slot, proposerIndex, root, timeIntoSlot); err != nil {
   148→			log.WithError(err).Error("Failed to broadcast missing data column sidecars")
   149→		}
   150→	})
   151→
   152→	return nil
   153→}
   154→
   155→func (s *Service) broadcastMissingDataColumnSidecars(
   156→	slot primitives.Slot,
   157→	proposerIndex primitives.ValidatorIndex,
   158→	root [fieldparams.RootLength]byte,
   159→	timeIntoSlot time.Duration,
   160→) error {
   161→	// Get the node ID.
   162→	nodeID := s.cfg.p2p.NodeID()
   163→
   164→	// Retrieve the local node info.
   165→	custodyGroupCount, err := s.cfg.p2p.CustodyGroupCount()
   166→	if err != nil {
   167→		return errors.Wrap(err, "custody group count")
   168→	}
   169→
   170→	localNodeInfo, _, err := peerdas.Info(nodeID, custodyGroupCount)
   171→	if err != nil {
   172→		return errors.Wrap(err, "peerdas info")
   173→	}
   174→
   175→	// Compute the missing data columns (data columns we should custody but we did not received via gossip.)
   176→	missingColumns := make([]uint64, 0, len(localNodeInfo.CustodyColumns))
   177→	for column := range localNodeInfo.CustodyColumns {
   178→		if !s.hasSeenDataColumnIndex(slot, proposerIndex, column) {
   179→			missingColumns = append(missingColumns, column)
   180→		}
   181→	}
   182→
   183→	// Return early if there are no missing data columns.
   184→	if len(missingColumns) == 0 {
   185→		return nil
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	// Load from the store the non received but reconstructed data column.
   189→	verifiedRODataColumnSidecars, err := s.cfg.dataColumnStorage.Get(root, missingColumns)
   190→	if err != nil {
   191→		return errors.Wrap(err, "data column storage get")
   192→	}
   193→
   194→	broadcastedColumns := make([]uint64, 0, len(verifiedRODataColumnSidecars))
   195→	for _, verifiedRODataColumn := range verifiedRODataColumnSidecars {
   196→		broadcastedColumns = append(broadcastedColumns, verifiedRODataColumn.Index)
   197→		// Compute the subnet for this column.
   198→		subnet := peerdas.ComputeSubnetForDataColumnSidecar(verifiedRODataColumn.Index)
   199→
   200→		// Broadcast the missing data column.
   201→		if err := s.cfg.p2p.BroadcastDataColumnSidecar(root, subnet, verifiedRODataColumn.DataColumnSidecar); err != nil {
   202→			log.WithError(err).Error("Broadcast data column")
   203→		}
   204→
   205→		// Now, we can set the data column as seen.
   206→		s.setSeenDataColumnIndex(slot, proposerIndex, verifiedRODataColumn.Index)
   207→	}
   208→
   209→	if logrus.GetLevel() >= logrus.DebugLevel {
   210→		// Sort for nice logging.
   211→		slices.Sort(broadcastedColumns)
   212→		slices.Sort(missingColumns)
   213→
   214→		log.WithFields(logrus.Fields{
   215→			"timeIntoSlot":   timeIntoSlot,
   216→			"missingColumns": missingColumns,
   217→			"broadcasted":    broadcastedColumns,
   218→		}).Debug("Start broadcasting not seen via gossip but reconstructed data columns")
   219→	}
   220→
   221→	return nil
   222→}
